title: Preventing Peptic Ulcer Complications
subtitle: Prevention, risk factors, screening, evidence, and practical actions related to preventing peptic ulcer complications.
evidence_strength: Established evidence supports major preventive strategies such as H. pylori eradication and NSAID management. Emerging evidence continues to clarify optimal screening and lifestyle interventions. Limitations exist due to antibiotic resistance and patient adherence factors.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
